evidence.observation: Growth pressure was 2.938 Torr with Ar at 100.4 sccm.
Pressure has risen progressively to 3.208 Torr, about 9% above growth entry, despite unchanged temperature and Ar setpoints.
Temperature 750.3 °C and Ar 100.1 sccm closely match setpoints; neither explains the sustained pressure rise.
Exhaust O2 sensor is not installed; O2 remains unavailable, so the required growth-atmosphere verification cannot be performed.

args.missing_evidence: A validated exhaust O2 measurement is needed to verify atmosphere; pressure tolerance/reference data and leak versus exhaust-conductance checks are needed to establish the cause of the pressure rise. No sample characterization is available.
